### 5.3 Resolution

**When a customer presses the intercom.** The agent, human or AI, should not have to log into another system, find the facility, find the lane, find the transaction, and reconstruct what happened.

| Method | Path | Summary | Scopes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `/v1/resolution/contexts` | Resolve a customer-service context from any known identifiers | `apx.resolution:read` |
| GET | `/v1/resolution/contexts/{id}` | Re-read (recompute) a resolution context | `apx.resolution:read` |
| GET | `/v1/resolution/contexts/{id}/allowed-actions` | Re-evaluate the allowed actions for a context | `apx.resolution:read` |
| GET | `/v1/credentials/{id}/passback` | Anti-passback status for a credential | `apx.control:read` |
| GET | `/v1/approvals` | List approval requests | `apx.resolution:read` |
| POST | `/v1/approvals` | Ask for approval of an action | `apx.support:manage` |
| GET | `/v1/approvals/{id}` | Read an approval request | `apx.resolution:read` |
| POST | `/v1/approvals/{id}/decide` | Approve or deny | `apx.support:manage` |

#### 5.3.1 POST /v1/resolution/contexts

**Resolve a customer-service context from any known identifiers.** THE aggregation call (Part 17 §17.2): accepts whatever parking-domain identifiers are known (lane, device, plate, ticket, credential, reservation code…) — telephony mapping stays on the call platform's side (§17.1) — and returns everything the server can resolve — issue classification, lane status, vehicle, session, account, passback, device status, recent overrides, support history — plus the policy-decided allowedActions. Sections the caller's scopes and `apx_places` grant could not read directly are omitted. May return `status: partial` with `pendingSources` rather than waiting on a slow source; re-read to refresh. Scope apx.resolution:read.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `post-apx-v1-resolution-contexts` |
| Origin | APX |
| Scopes | `apx.resolution:read` |
| Request body | ResolutionResolveRequest |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | ResolutionContext | The resolved context (possibly partial). |
| 400 | Problem | No usable identifier supplied: the body carries none of the identifying members (device, place, lane, session, holder, credential, plate, ticketNumber, reservationCode) — problem type `invalid-request` (Part 17 §17.1). |
| 401 | Problem | Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token (problem type `unauthenticated`, Part 12). |
| 403 | Problem | Insufficient scope (problem type `insufficient-scope`) or place grant (`insufficient-grant`) for this operation (Part 9). |
| 404 | Problem | No identifier resolved to anything this implementation knows. |
| 422 | Problem | A `commsPoint`, `callerId`, `dialedNumber` or `commsDeviceId` this implementation does not hold (`comms-point-unknown`, Part 17 §17.1 and Part 26 §26.4), or a registered code value outside the served registries (`reference-unknown`). |
| 429 | Problem | Rate limited (problem type `rate-limited`, Part 12). |

#### 5.4.4 PUT /v1/support/interactions/{id}

**Update (complete) a support interaction.** Replaces the interaction — typically to complete a record opened when the call was answered with `endedAt`, `resolution`, `summary`, and `actions` (Part 17 §17.6). Optimistic concurrency per Part 4 §4.2a: send the `version` last read as `If-Match` (or in the body); a stale one is 409 `version-conflict`. The server increments `version` and publishes `apx.support.interaction.recorded.v1` again; consumers tell a create from an update by `version`. `id` in the body, when present, MUST equal the path id. Scope apx.support:manage.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `put-apx-v1-support-interactions-id` |
| Origin | APX |
| Scopes | `apx.support:manage` |
| Request body | SupportInteraction |

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | yes | string uuid | SupportInteraction id. |
| `If-Match` | header | no | string | The `version` the client last read, as an entity tag (`"7"`). A stale value is 409 `version-conflict`; nothing is written (Part 4 §4.2a). Equivalent to sending `version` in the body. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | SupportInteraction | The updated interaction. |
| 400 | Problem | The request is malformed: the body or a parameter fails the operation's schema or a normative field rule (problem type `invalid-request`, with an `errors[]` member naming each offending JSON Pointer), or a REQUIRED Idempotency-Key is absent (`idempotency-key-required`). Part 12. |
| 401 | Problem | Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token (problem type `unauthenticated`, Part 12). |
| 403 | Problem | Insufficient scope (problem type `insufficient-scope`) or place grant (`insufficient-grant`) for this operation (Part 9). |
| 404 | Problem | The addressed resource does not exist (problem type `target-not-found`). A resource at a place outside the caller's `apx_places` grant is 403 `insufficient-grant` instead (Part 9 §9.3). A resource that exists but lies outside a narrower ownership scope (a merchant's own programs, a valet customer's own ticket) is reported as 404, so the answer never confirms another party's record exists (Part 9 §9.3a). |
| 409 | Problem | Stale `version` (`version-conflict`, Part 4 §4.2a); nothing is written. |
| 429 | Problem | Rate limited (problem type `rate-limited`, Part 12). |

## 6 Webhooks (event deliveries)

### 6.1 Webhooks

| Method | Path | Summary | Scopes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| POST | `apx-event` | Signed APX event delivery |  |
| POST | `apx-native-event` | APDS EventTypeEnum topic delivery |  |
| POST | `apx.subscription.failed.v1` | A subscription exhausted its retry schedule |  |
| POST | `apx.data.observation.created.v1` | An Observation was ingested |  |
| POST | `apx.data.observation.updated.v1` | An ingested Observation was replaced |  |
| POST | `apx.reservation.noshow.v1` | A reservation reached its no-show condition |  |

#### 6.1.1 POST apx-event

**Signed APX event delivery.** Every webhook delivery POSTs one EventEnvelope with headers `APX-Signature` (v1=HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + body)), `APX-Timestamp` (RFC 3339, ±5 min replay window), `APX-Delivery-Id` (unique per attempt; envelope `id` is stable across retries), and `APX-Key-Id` (REQUIRED during secret-rotation overlap windows — Part 9 §9.4). Respond 2xx to acknowledge; anything else triggers the normative retry schedule (Part 8).

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `receive-apx-event` |
| Origin | APX webhook |
| Scopes | none |
| Request body | EventEnvelope |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | — | Acknowledged. |

#### 6.1.2 POST apx-native-event

**APDS EventTypeEnum topic delivery.** A delivery on an APDS 4.1 topic (`SessionCreated`, `PlaceUpdated`, …): `type` is an APDS `EventTypeEnum` value, `data` the APDS `EventData` shape (the created/updated entity; for a `*Deleted` topic the last state), and `subject` references the entity (Part 5 §5.4, Part 8 §8.2). Signed and retried like every delivery.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `receive-apx-native-event` |
| Origin | APX webhook |
| Scopes | none |
| Request body | EventEnvelope / object |

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `APX-Signature` | header | yes | string | `v1=` + hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, APX-Timestamp + "." + raw body), computed per attempt. |
| `APX-Timestamp` | header | yes | string date-time | RFC 3339 time of THIS attempt (not of the event or of the first attempt). |
| `APX-Delivery-Id` | header | yes | string uuid | UUID unique per attempt; the envelope `id` is the dedup key. |
| `APX-Key-Id` | header | no | string | The signing key's id — REQUIRED during a rotation overlap (Part 9 §9.4). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | — | Acknowledged. |

#### 6.1.3 POST apx.subscription.failed.v1

**A subscription exhausted its retry schedule.** Published when a subscription enters `failed` (Part 8 §8.3). `subject` references the subscription (`className` `ApxEventSubscription`); `data` is a SubscriptionFailure. Delivered to other subscriptions of the same `apx_org` that list the topic, never to the failed one.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `receive-apx-subscription-failed` |
| Origin | APX webhook |
| Scopes | none |
| Request body | EventEnvelope / object |

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `APX-Signature` | header | yes | string | `v1=` + hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, APX-Timestamp + "." + raw body), computed per attempt. |
| `APX-Timestamp` | header | yes | string date-time | RFC 3339 time of THIS attempt (not of the event or of the first attempt). |
| `APX-Delivery-Id` | header | yes | string uuid | UUID unique per attempt; the envelope `id` is the dedup key. |
| `APX-Key-Id` | header | no | string | The signing key's id — REQUIRED during a rotation overlap (Part 9 §9.4). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | — | Acknowledged. |

#### 6.1.4 POST apx.data.observation.created.v1

**An Observation was ingested.** One event per ingested read. `data` is the APDS `ObservationElement` (an ingested ObservationSet yields one event per element); `subject` references it with `className` `ObservationElement`; publishers MUST populate `elementIds` with the observing lane or place, which is the event's place binding (Part 8 §8.5). Plate values are subject to Part 9 §9.6.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `receive-apx-data-observation-created` |
| Origin | APX webhook |
| Scopes | none |
| Request body | EventEnvelope / object |

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `APX-Signature` | header | yes | string | `v1=` + hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, APX-Timestamp + "." + raw body), computed per attempt. |
| `APX-Timestamp` | header | yes | string date-time | RFC 3339 time of THIS attempt (not of the event or of the first attempt). |
| `APX-Delivery-Id` | header | yes | string uuid | UUID unique per attempt; the envelope `id` is the dedup key. |
| `APX-Key-Id` | header | no | string | The signing key's id — REQUIRED during a rotation overlap (Part 9 §9.4). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | — | Acknowledged. |

#### 6.1.5 POST apx.data.observation.updated.v1

**An ingested Observation was replaced.** Published whenever an ingested Observation changes — for example the LPR system revising `accessEvent` through `PUT /v1/lpr/reads/{observation}/access-event` (Part 13 §13.3a(4), §13.4), or a reviewer's plate decision through `PUT /v1/lpr/reads/{observation}/plate` (§13.3a(4a)). `data` is the APDS `ObservationElement` as it now stands; `subject` and the place binding (`elementIds`) are as for `apx.data.observation.created.v1`. Consumers key on the Observation id and keep the highest `version`. Plate values are subject to Part 9 §9.6.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `receive-apx-data-observation-updated` |
| Origin | APX webhook |
| Scopes | none |
| Request body | EventEnvelope / object |

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `APX-Signature` | header | yes | string | `v1=` + hex HMAC-SHA256(secret, APX-Timestamp + "." + raw body), computed per attempt. |
| `APX-Timestamp` | header | yes | string date-time | RFC 3339 time of THIS attempt (not of the event or of the first attempt). |
| `APX-Delivery-Id` | header | yes | string uuid | UUID unique per attempt; the envelope `id` is the dedup key. |
| `APX-Key-Id` | header | no | string | The signing key's id — REQUIRED during a rotation overlap (Part 9 §9.4). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | — | Acknowledged. |

#### 6.1.6 POST apx.reservation.noshow.v1

**A reservation reached its no-show condition.** `data` is a ReservationSummary (`reservation`, `reservationState` `noShow`, `plannedStart`); `subject` references the AssignedRight (Part 14 §14.1, Part 8 §8.7).

## 7 APDS 4.1 native routes

### 7.1 Places

| Method | Path | Summary | Scopes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/places` | List Places | `po` `sp` `ep` `ad` |
| POST | `/places` | Create Place | `po` |
| GET | `/places/{id}` | Get Place | `po` `sp` `ep` `ad` |
| PUT | `/places/{id}` | Update Place | `po` |
| DELETE | `/places/{id}` | Delete Place | `po` |

#### 7.1.1 GET /places

**List Places.** Returns a list of places potentially filtered by a combination of : * __latitude__, __longitude__ and __radius__ : retrieve all places within a geographic area, * __types__ : retrieve all places of the given type, * __right_type__ : retrieve all places associated with the right specification type, * __structure_type__ : retrieve all places associated with the specified structure type, * __structure_grade__ : retrieve all places associated with the specified structure grade, * __name__ : retrieve all places which match the name of the facilities, * __layer__ : specify the maximum hierarchy element layer desired, * __operator__ : the id of the operator of this location * __modified_since__ : retrieve all places that have changed from that given instant onwards, * __expand__ : a comma-separated list of optional object attributes associated to a place that should be included in the result set.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `get-places` |
| Origin | APDS 4.1 native route |
| Scopes | `po`, `sp`, `ep`, `ad` |
| Request body | — |

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `latitude` | query | no | number float | Location latitude to use as filter (mandatory if __longitude__ and __radius__ are defined) |
| `longitude` | query | no | number float | Location longitude to use as filter (mandatory if __latitude__ and __radius__ are defined) |
| `radius` | query | no | integer | Number of metres to use as search filter from given position (mandatory if __latitude__ and __longitude__ are defined) |
| `type` | query | no | array of HierarchyElementTypeEnum | Comma-separated list of place types to consider. All will be assumed if parameter is not used or left blank. |
| `right_type` | query | no | array of RightSpecificationTypeEnum | Comma-separated list of right specification types to consider. All will be assumed if parameter is not used or left blank. |
| `structure_type` | query | no | array of StructureTypeEnum | Comma-separated list of types of structure in the hierarchy to consider (all will be assumed if parameter is not used or left blank) |
| `structure_grade` | query | no | array of StructureGradeEnum | Comma-separated list of Structure grades in the hierarchy to consider (all will be assumed if parameter is not used or left blank) |
| `name` | query | no | string | Name of place hierarchy element (in any of its supported languages) |
| `layer` | query | no | integer | Most detailed (lower-level) layer of data desired. 0 (zero) being the first level (and higher numbers correspond to lower-levels of information). If left empty, the entire place hierarchy that matches the remaining parameters will be returned. |
| `operator` | query | no | string | id of the parking operator in charge of the location(s) |
| `modified_since` | query | no | integer | Unix epoch __instant__ to filter results that have changed or have been deleted after the given instant. If __expand__ attributes are requested, then this parameter will also apply to those objects. When this attribute is used, the result set will also include a list of deleted references to avoid storing stale data. |
| `expand` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of optional object attributes associated to a place hierarchy element that should be included in the result set. |
| `page` | query | no | integer | The page number for paginated responses. |
| `mode` | query | no | string (full, change) | APX change feed (Part 5 §5.2): `full` (default — the route's ordinary list; on a native APDS route, exactly stock APDS 4.1) or `change` (the changes after `cursor`: a ChangeFeedPage on a native route, the route's own list envelope with the change-page members on an APX list route, rule 8; on an APX list route without a cursor, an empty page holding the current head cursor). |
| `cursor` | query | no | string | Opaque change-feed cursor from a previous change page. Only meaningful with `mode=change`; a refused cursor is 404 `target-not-found` (Part 5 §5.2 rules 2 and 5). |
| `place` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of unique place ids according to the requested types. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | HierarchyElementList / ChangeFeedPage | Ok |
| 401 | Problem | Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token (problem type `unauthenticated`, Part 12). |
| 403 | Problem | Insufficient scope (problem type `insufficient-scope`) or place grant (`insufficient-grant`) for this operation (Part 9). |
| 404 | Problem | mode=change only: the cursor is unknown, older than the retention window, or was issued for another (class, credential, filter set) — problem type `target-not-found`; re-sync with mode=full (Part 5 §5.2 rules 2 and 5). The cursor is an APX parameter, so this refusal is always a Problem. |
| 429 | Problem | Rate limited (problem type `rate-limited`, Part 12). |

#### 7.4.1 GET /rights/specs

**List RightSpecifications.** Returns a list of right specifications potentially filtered by a combination of : * __latitude__, __longitude__ and __radius__ : retrieve all right specifications used in a geographic area (via their associated place), * a list of __Places__ : retrieve all right specifications connected to any of the given places, * __issuer__ : the id of the entity that issued the right specification * __modified_since__ : retrieve all right specifications that have changed from that given instant onwards, * __expand__ : a comma-separated list of optional object attributes associated to a right specification that should be included in the result set.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `get-right_specs` |
| Origin | APDS 4.1 native route |
| Scopes | `po`, `sp`, `ep`, `ad` |
| Request body | — |

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `latitude` | query | no | number float | Location latitude to use as filter (mandatory if __longitude__ and __radius__ are defined) |
| `longitude` | query | no | number float | Location longitude to use as filter (mandatory if __latitude__ and __radius__ are defined) |
| `radius` | query | no | integer | Number of metres to use as search filter from given position (mandatory if __latitude__ and __longitude__ are defined) |
| `place` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of unique place ids according to the requested types. |
| `type` | query | no | array of HierarchyElementTypeEnum | Comma-separated list of place types to consider. All will be assumed if parameter is not used or left blank. |
| `modified_since` | query | no | integer | Unix epoch __instant__ to filter results that have changed or have been deleted after the given instant. If __expand__ attributes are requested, then this parameter will also apply to those objects. When this attribute is used, the result set will also include a list of deleted references to avoid storing stale data. |
| `issuer` | query | no | string | id of the entity that issued the returned records |
| `expand` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of optional object attributes associated to a right specification that should be included in the result set. |
| `page` | query | no | integer | The page number for paginated responses. |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | RightSpecificationList | OK |
| 401 | Problem | Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token (problem type `unauthenticated`, Part 12). |
| 403 | Problem | Insufficient scope (problem type `insufficient-scope`) or place grant (`insufficient-grant`) for this operation (Part 9). |
| 429 | Problem | Rate limited (problem type `rate-limited`, Part 12). |

#### 7.5.1 GET /rates

**List RateTables.** Returns a list of rate potentially filtered by a combination of : * __latitude__, __longitude__ and __radius__ : retrieve all rates used in a geographic area (via their associated assigned rights and place), * a list of __places__ : retrieve all rates connected to assigned rights that belong to any of the given places, * a list of __right specifications__ : retrieve all rates connected to any of the given right specifications, * __issuer__ : the id of the rate responsible party (i.e. the issuer of the rate table) * __modified_since__ : retrieve all rates that have changed from that given instant onwards, * __expand__ : a comma-separated list of optional object attributes associated to a rate that should be included in the result set.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `get-rates` |
| Origin | APDS 4.1 native route |
| Scopes | `po`, `sp`, `ep`, `ad` |
| Request body | — |

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `latitude` | query | no | number float | Location latitude to use as filter (mandatory if __longitude__ and __radius__ are defined) |
| `longitude` | query | no | number float | Location longitude to use as filter (mandatory if __latitude__ and __radius__ are defined) |
| `radius` | query | no | integer | Number of metres to use as search filter from given position (mandatory if __latitude__ and __longitude__ are defined) |
| `place` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of unique place ids according to the requested types. |
| `right_spec` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of unique right specification ids according to the requested types. |
| `modified_since` | query | no | integer | Unix epoch __instant__ to filter results that have changed or have been deleted after the given instant. If __expand__ attributes are requested, then this parameter will also apply to those objects. When this attribute is used, the result set will also include a list of deleted references to avoid storing stale data. |
| `expand` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of optional attributes associated to a rate that should be included in the result set. |
| `issuer` | query | no | string | id of the entity that issued the returned records |
| `page` | query | no | integer | The page number for paginated responses. |
| `mode` | query | no | string (full, change) | APX change feed (Part 5 §5.2): `full` (default — the route's ordinary list; on a native APDS route, exactly stock APDS 4.1) or `change` (the changes after `cursor`: a ChangeFeedPage on a native route, the route's own list envelope with the change-page members on an APX list route, rule 8; on an APX list route without a cursor, an empty page holding the current head cursor). |
| `cursor` | query | no | string | Opaque change-feed cursor from a previous change page. Only meaningful with `mode=change`; a refused cursor is 404 `target-not-found` (Part 5 §5.2 rules 2 and 5). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | RateTableList / ChangeFeedPage | OK |
| 401 | Problem | Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token (problem type `unauthenticated`, Part 12). |
| 403 | Problem | Insufficient scope (problem type `insufficient-scope`) or place grant (`insufficient-grant`) for this operation (Part 9). |
| 404 | Problem | mode=change only: the cursor is unknown, older than the retention window, or was issued for another (class, credential, filter set) — problem type `target-not-found`; re-sync with mode=full (Part 5 §5.2 rules 2 and 5). The cursor is an APX parameter, so this refusal is always a Problem. |
| 429 | Problem | Rate limited (problem type `rate-limited`, Part 12). |

#### 7.6.1 GET /sessions

**List Sessions.** Returns a list of sessions potentially filtered by a combination of : * __latitude__, __longitude__ and __radius__ : retrieve all sessions occurring in a geographic area (via their associated place), * a list of __Places__ : retrieve all sessions connected to any of the given places, * a list of __RightSpecifications__ : retrieve all sessions with segments using any of the given right specifications, * a list of __Credentials__ : retrieve all sessions linked to the given credentials, * __start_before__ : retrieve all sessions starting before that given instant, * __end_before__ : retrieve all sessions ending before that given instant, * __start_after__ : retrieve all sessions starting after that given instant, * __end_after__ : retrieve all sessions ending after that given instant, * __modified_since__ : retrieve all sessions that have changed from that given instant onwards, * __expand__ : a comma-separated list of optional object attributes associated to a session or its segment.s that should be included in the result set.

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `get-sessions` |
| Origin | APDS 4.1 native route |
| Scopes | `po`, `sp`, `ep`, `ad` |
| Request body | — |

| Parameter | In | Required | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `latitude` | query | no | number float | Location latitude to use as filter (mandatory if __longitude__ and __radius__ are defined) |
| `longitude` | query | no | number float | Location longitude to use as filter (mandatory if __latitude__ and __radius__ are defined) |
| `radius` | query | no | integer | Number of metres to use as search filter from given position (mandatory if __latitude__ and __longitude__ are defined) |
| `place` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of unique place ids according to the requested types. |
| `type` | query | no | array of HierarchyElementTypeEnum | Comma-separated list of place types to consider. All will be assumed if parameter is not used or left blank. |
| `credential_id` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of unique credential ids according to the requested types. |
| `credential_type` | query | no | array of CredentialTypeEnum | Comma-separated list of credential types to consider. All will be assumed if parameter is not used or left blank. |
| `right_spec` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of unique right specification ids according to the requested types. |
| `right_type` | query | no | array of RightSpecificationTypeEnum | Comma-separated list of right specification types to consider. All will be assumed if parameter is not used or left blank. |
| `start_before` | query | no | integer | Unix epoch __instant__ to filter results starting before the given instant. |
| `end_before` | query | no | integer | Unix epoch __instant__ to filter results ending before the given instant. |
| `start_after` | query | no | integer | Unix epoch __instant__ to filter results starting after the given instant. |
| `end_after` | query | no | integer | Unix epoch __instant__ to filter results ending after the given instant. |
| `modified_since` | query | no | integer | Unix epoch __instant__ to filter results that have changed or have been deleted after the given instant. If __expand__ attributes are requested, then this parameter will also apply to those objects. When this attribute is used, the result set will also include a list of deleted references to avoid storing stale data. |
| `expand` | query | no | array of string | Comma-separated list of optional attributes associated to a session or its segment.s that should be included in the result set. |
| `page` | query | no | integer | The page number for paginated responses. |
| `mode` | query | no | string (full, change) | APX change feed (Part 5 §5.2): `full` (default — the route's ordinary list; on a native APDS route, exactly stock APDS 4.1) or `change` (the changes after `cursor`: a ChangeFeedPage on a native route, the route's own list envelope with the change-page members on an APX list route, rule 8; on an APX list route without a cursor, an empty page holding the current head cursor). |
| `cursor` | query | no | string | Opaque change-feed cursor from a previous change page. Only meaningful with `mode=change`; a refused cursor is 404 `target-not-found` (Part 5 §5.2 rules 2 and 5). |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | SessionList / ChangeFeedPage | OK |
| 401 | Problem | Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token (problem type `unauthenticated`, Part 12). |
| 403 | Problem | Insufficient scope (problem type `insufficient-scope`) or place grant (`insufficient-grant`) for this operation (Part 9). |
| 404 | Problem | mode=change only: the cursor is unknown, older than the retention window, or was issued for another (class, credential, filter set) — problem type `target-not-found`; re-sync with mode=full (Part 5 §5.2 rules 2 and 5). The cursor is an APX parameter, so this refusal is always a Problem. |
| 429 | Problem | Rate limited (problem type `rate-limited`, Part 12). |

#### 7.6.2 POST /sessions

**Create Session.** Creates a new session, along with one or more segment.s. It also allows the creation of assigned rights, for scenarios in which they must be created simultaneously (e.g. off-street and on-street short stays).

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Operation id | `create-session` |
| Origin | APDS 4.1 native route |
| Scopes | `sp` |
| Request body | Session |

| Response | Body | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | ResponseStatus | Created |
| 400 | ResponseStatus | Bad Request. APX (Part 5 §5.1a, Part 12 §12.1): a client sending `Accept: application/problem+json` receives problem type `invalid-request` (with `errors[]`) instead of ResponseStatus. |
| 401 | Problem | Missing, malformed, expired, or revoked access token (problem type `unauthenticated`, Part 12). |
| 403 | Problem | Insufficient scope (problem type `insufficient-scope`) or place grant (`insufficient-grant`) for this operation (Part 9). |
| 409 | ResponseStatus | Conflict. APX (Part 5 §5.1a, Part 12 §12.1): a client sending `Accept: application/problem+json` receives problem type `id-collision` (client-supplied id already exists), or `read-already-bound` (a read in `apds-ext:apx:session-detail@1.0` is bound as `entry` or `exit` to another Session of the same place that the write does not name in `supersedes`, Part 5 §5.8 rule 2), instead of ResponseStatus; nothing is written. |
| 422 | Problem | The Session's `apds-ext:apx:session-detail@1.0` breaks a consistency rule of Part 5 §5.8 — more than one `representative` read, `lifecycle` `open` with an `actualEnd` or any other `lifecycle` without one, or a `parent` whose `hierarchyElement` is not an ancestor of this Session's (problem type `request-unprocessable`); or a read naming no Observation visible to the caller (`reference-unknown`). Nothing is written. |
| 429 | Problem | Rate limited (problem type `rate-limited`, Part 12). |

## Annex S (informative) Security schemes and scopes

Scopes are defined in the OpenAPI security schemes below and explained in APX Part 9. As elsewhere in this document, the OpenAPI document wins where the two differ.

| Scheme | Scope | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| oAuth | `po` | Parking Operator |
| oAuth | `sp` | Service Provider |
| oAuth | `ep` | Enforcement Provider |
| oAuth | `ad` | Administrator |
| apxOAuth | `apx.data:read` | Read parking data via APDS-native routes |
| apxOAuth | `apx.data:write` | Create/update parking data via APDS-native routes |
| apxOAuth | `apx.control:read` | Read commands, lanes, and device status |
| apxOAuth | `apx.control:execute` | Execute commands (vend gate, lost ticket, push rate, apply validation…) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.alerts:read` | Read alerts |
| apxOAuth | `apx.alerts:write` | Raise, acknowledge, and resolve alerts |
| apxOAuth | `apx.subscriptions:manage` | Create and manage event subscriptions |
| apxOAuth | `apx.accounts:read` | Look up accounts and balances |
| apxOAuth | `apx.payments:write` | Take payments and post accounting write-backs |
| apxOAuth | `apx.lpr:read` | LPR plate/ticket cross-lookup |
| apxOAuth | `apx.reservations:manage` | Quote, book, amend, cancel reservations |
| apxOAuth | `apx.permits:manage` | Issue and manage permits |
| apxOAuth | `apx.tolling:manage` | Create and manage toll transactions |
| apxOAuth | `apx.resolution:read` | Resolve and read customer-service resolution contexts and allowed actions |
| apxOAuth | `apx.support:manage` | Record and read support-interaction history |
| apxOAuth | `apx.violations:read` | Read violations and run the enforcement eligibility check |
| apxOAuth | `apx.violations:manage` | Create, review, issue, settle, appeal, and void violations |
| apxOAuth | `apx.validations:read` | Read validation programs, issuances, redemptions, and statements |
| apxOAuth | `apx.validations:manage` | Enrol and update programs, issue stock, reverse redemptions, close statements |
| apxOAuth | `apx.validations:redeem` | Merchant scope — check codes, issue own stock, record redemptions, read own programs and statements (limited to the token's apx_org) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.credentials:read` | Read credentials and their access-event history |
| apxOAuth | `apx.credentials:manage` | Issue, activate, suspend, resume, report lost, revoke, and replace credentials |
| apxOAuth | `apx.valet:read` | Read valet tickets and the retrieval queue |
| apxOAuth | `apx.valet:manage` | Take custody, park, stage, hand back, and manage retrievals |
| apxOAuth | `apx.valet:request` | Customer scope — request or cancel retrieval and read status/ETA for the caller's own ticket (text, app, web, voice bot) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.platelists:read` | Read plate lists and their entries, plate values included (Part 24) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.platelists:manage` | Create and maintain plate lists and entries (Part 24) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.ui:launch` | Open a vendor screen for an agent and read the launches it issued (Part 25) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.ui:read` | Read UI launches and the actions recorded in them (Part 25) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.ui:record` | The surface's own scope; record actions done in a launched screen and close it (Part 25) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.siteconfig:read` | Read a place's equipment, cameras, comms points, display records and external ids; resolve another system's id (Part 26) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.siteconfig:manage` | Add, replace and remove comms points (Part 26) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.cameras:view` | Obtain short-lived camera view links, logged against the agent (Part 26) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.displays:record` | The scope of the system that drives a sign; record that a message was shown (Part 26 §26.9) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.compliance:read` | Read the stay-compliance status on Sessions; without it the decoration is left out (Part 5 §5.9) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.compliance:write` | Write the stay-compliance status on Sessions, beside the Session write scope (Part 5 §5.9) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.digest:use` | Receive the credential digest keys (Part 9 §9.6 rule 6) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.replication:write` | Replay another implementation's records with their original provenance and lifecycle times (Part 18 §18.6) |
| apxOAuth | `apx.charging:read` | read charging-point status (with bay presence) and charging sessions |
| apxOAuth | `apx.charging:manage` | bridge scope; push point availability, bay observations, open sessions, report timeline events, attach settlement |
| apxOAuth | `apx.charging:status` | customer scope; minimized read of the caller's own charging session and the place's charger availability (app, text, voice bot) |
